style.backgroundSystem: matte plaster wall #F4F0E6 with a faint #F3DFA3 grid-dot texture, pale oak wooden rail #C9A97A as the recurring horizontal anchor
style.iconSystem: thin #B0473C curved-arc line icons, uniform 2px stroke, open arcs and partial circles, no filled shapes, no gradients
style.lightingSystem: soft warm 5000K key light from the upper right, wide gentle fill, low-contrast falloff, soft contact shadows, no harsh specular highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: warm playful kidswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #F4F0E6 background, #F3DFA3 and #5F7FA6 secondary, #B0473C accent; warm 5000K temperature; soft key light from the upper right with gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; consistent matte plaster wall background plus a pale oak wooden rail #C9A97A; rounded bold sans-serif with #B0473C label bars; thin #B0473C curved-arc line icons, uniform 2px stroke; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no palette changes; only #F4F0E6, #F3DFA3, #5F7FA6, #B0473C and neutral garment tones
no mixed fonts; rounded bold sans-serif only
no random backgrounds; the plaster wall plus pale oak rail system repeats every shot
no inconsistent lighting; 5000K key from the upper right in every shot
no mismatched icon styles; thin #B0473C curved-arc line icons only
no brand wordmark, shop name, logo, watermark, membership badge or QR code
no price, discount, coupon, shipping claim, sales count or rating
no size chart numbers, no age range, no height or weight range
no fibre-composition percentage, no fabric weight, no yarn count, no origin claim
no certification, national standard reference, test report, patent or lab endorsement
no antibacterial, hypoallergenic or material-safety claim
no child shown alone, climbing, standing on furniture or in an unsafe pose; any child appears only flat-laid or cropped above the jaw line, never a recognizable full face
no added neck cords, drawcords or straps that are absent from the reference product
no invented construction; keep hood, kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and ribbed hem exactly as referenced
style.presentationRules: product always grounded with a visible contact shadow; flat-lay shots photographed directly overhead and kept square to frame; hanging shot keeps the wooden rail truly level; stable product scale, no tilt of vertical lines
style.surfaceSystem: smooth matte plaster wall plus a pale oak wood rail and a matte pale-wood plank table #C9A97A for flat-lay shots
style.typography: rounded bold sans-serif only, headline inside a #B0473C label bar with #F4F0E6 text, no serif, no script, no handwritten
